hero.name: Nguyen Viet Hien
hero.title: Senior Software Engineer
summary: Senior software engineer with about 20 years of experience in device control, embedded software, real-time monitoring, and enterprise applications.
Develops and supports UAV ground-control systems with C++/Qt/QML, including flight controller, camera, gimbal, payload, and network integration.
Brings hands-on experience from industrial device software through web/API systems, with a practical, end-to-end approach to troubleshooting and system integration.

education: 2012.09 – 2014.06 · Master of Business Administration, Foreign Trade University, Hanoi
2001.09 – 2006.05 · BSc in Information Technology, Hanoi University of Science and Technology
Languages · Vietnamese (native), Korean (business/daily conversation), English (business/daily conversation, TOEIC 710)

experiences.title: Senior Software Engineer
highlights: Develop and maintain ALES UAV ground-control software based on QGroundControl using C++ and Qt/QML.
Analyze and support MAVLink, UDP/TCP, MQTT, and RTSP telemetry, control, and video-streaming issues.
Integrate PX4/ArduPilot, cameras, gimbals, wireless modules, and other external equipment.
Investigate logs and field issues across Android/Linux, USB/Serial, permissions, and network environments.

experiences.title: Senior Software Engineer
highlights: Developed and maintained Windows device-control applications and web monitoring features for measurement equipment.
Implemented server/API integrations and improved database structures and queries for operational data.
Diagnosed incidents from logs and communication traces, delivering patches and supporting customer requirements.

experiences.title: Senior Software Engineer
highlights: Built and maintained enterprise monitoring systems with C#, ASP.NET Web API, Angular, and Java Spring.
Developed real-time charts, dashboards, alarms, and industrial data integrations using SignalR, Highcharts, and OPC/PLC.
Improved API/database integration, reliability, performance, security, and operational workflows.

experiences.title: Software Engineer / Technical Lead
highlights: Designed and developed enterprise web, application, API, and database systems for global clients.
Implemented Web API/WCF services, authentication, payment, workflow, and performance improvements.
Collaborated with international customers and development teams across Australia, Singapore, and the UK.

experiences.title: Software Engineer
highlights: Developed and maintained enterprise, CRM, and e-commerce systems for US and Japanese customers.
Delivered C#/Java services, interfaces, database integrations, and production issue resolution.

Implemented device settings UI, XML/INI configuration, multithreading, and PC-to-device troubleshooting.
